summary: Ch.1 (omegaverse): Hayato, an alpha of 19, has been bonded to his childhood friend Riichi, an omega six years older, since he bit him by accident at age 10. Riichi set strict rules until Hayato turns 20 (touch only shoulders to hands, only kissing, dates at home or in public) and keeps him at arm's length; Hayato fears he is only tolerated. Riichi actually loves him but holds back so Hayato can choose freely as an adult. Hayato decides to provoke an answer: he asks for their 'routine' kiss in his room and pushes past the rules; Riichi responds, and they are intimate for the first time. Riichi ends horrified: 'Why did I... do it after all...'

Ch.2: Riichi, guilt-ridden and dreaming of that night, resolves to hold the line until Hayato is 20. Hayato turns up at his flat and argues his way into staying over ('your place counts as outside my home'). Riichi drags him on an all-day date to tire him out, notices how popular Hayato is as an alpha, and realises he would want Hayato even if they hadn't bonded by accident; Hayato says he only loves Riichi and means to cherish him. At night Hayato notices Riichi's sweet scent and touches him, but only to check for a fever; Riichi has one, and Hayato goes out for medicine. Alone, Riichi gives in to his own arousal, then takes a suppressant and airs the room, determined to last until next year.

Ch.3: Flashback -- Riichi's first heat came late, at 16, in hospital; before that, little Hayato often comforted him by his scent, and while playing at 'how bonding works' a sleepy Hayato bit his nape for real, and they bonded. Now the doctor (Riichi's brother Fujita) says only Riichi still clings to the rules; both mothers no longer care. On their anniversary Hayato buys the famous cheesecake; in a park at night they kiss, Riichi kisses back hard, then pushes him away, ashamed. Hayato texts an apology. Riichi tells Dr Fujita he 'accidentally threw away' his suppressants and gets a double prescription; Fujita notes it and worries. To be continued.

Hayato notices that Riichi is lying about the cause of his persistent sleepiness and, after consulting Kaname, discovers that he has been misusing heat suppressants before their dates. Hayato initially reduces their meetings to protect Riichi, then brings injectable alpha suppressants and asks him to explain; Riichi admits that he loves Hayato and has been taking the drugs to control his attraction and uphold their agreed rules. Relieved by their honest conversation, Riichi unexpectedly enters heat early, and Hayato cares for him through several days while using suppressants himself to keep their promise despite their growing intimacy. Afterward, Riichi realizes that Hayato honored their agreement and shyly wishes they could remain together exclusively. Hayato insists that they resume their rules and wait until the promised birthday, leaving Riichi recognizing his maturity and eagerly wishing the day would arrive.

After Hayato is reprimanded for misusing alpha suppressants, he and Riichi tell their doctor and families that they will honor their existing restrictions until Hayato turns twenty, then move forward together as committed partners. Riichi worries that he cannot express affection as openly as Hayato, so he arranges a birthday dinner and an overnight stay to show his feelings through his actions. Once Hayato's birthday arrives, they become intimate, and Hayato reassures Riichi that he now recognizes the love Riichi has always shown him. At Riichi's request, Hayato willingly gives him a new bonding bite, although outside of heat it is only symbolic. They affirm that the older bite mark represents their unchanged feelings and the hardships they overcame together, then head out for lunch, eager to make more shared memories.

Hayato observes that Riichi, normally dependable and devoted to caring for others, becomes more openly affectionate and expressive about his desires during heat. Discovering that Riichi enjoys a more assertive partner, Hayato enthusiastically indulges him, though afterward Riichi shyly complains that their intimacy lasted for hours. A bonus story shows them adjusting to living together after Hayato starts his first job, with each initially hesitating to initiate intimacy out of concern for the other. They reconnect and promise to keep openly checking each other’s feelings throughout their lives, especially when upset. Riichi reflects that their lifelong bond as childhood friends and their unusually timed development as an omega and alpha make them seem like destined partners. The chapter ends at a New Year gathering, where Kaname is still getting used to seeing the couple so close together.
